info.title: Attendance Checker API
info.description: csmju-attendance-checker - CSMJU2030 subsystem. Every /api/v1 route needs the Core Hub access token: the HttpOnly session cookie set by /auth/callback, or a Bearer header.

ErrorCode.description: One of the codes in standards/contracts/error-codes.json.

code.description: One of the codes in standards/contracts/error-codes.json.

details.description: Field errors for VALIDATION_ERROR, or extra facts such as `distanceMeters`.

expiresAt.description: The token's `exp`. Past it the next call returns 401 and /auth/login runs again.

coreRole.description: Core Hub role from the token, e.g. `student` or `lecturer`.

courseCode.description: Core Hub course code with its version, e.g. 10301111-1.

courseName.description: From Core Hub when the course is in its catalog, else the name typed before the link.

courseInCatalog.description: False for a section typed in before the Core Hub link, or while Core Hub is unreachable.

academicYear.description: Gregorian year; the UI shows the Buddhist era.

radiusMeters.description: Students must be within this many meters of the check-in point.

ownerCoreUserId.description: Core Hub user (`sub`) of the staff member who owns the section.

courseCode.description: Core Hub course code with its version, e.g. 10301111-1 (GET /api/v1/courses).

addedAt.description: When the student was added to the roster.

added.description: How many student ids were newly added.

alreadyOnRoster.description: Ids that were already on the roster and were skipped.

personCodes.description: Student ids to add. Ids already on the roster are skipped.

recordCount.description: Students who checked in to this session.
Students who checked in to this session.

inRoster.description: On the section's roster? `null` while the section has no roster yet.

coreUserId.description: Core Hub user id (`sub`) of the student.

personCode.description: Student id from Core Hub's /people/me; null for an account not linked to a person.

distanceMeters.description: Distance from the room's check-in point, in meters.

coreUserId.description: Core Hub user id (`sub`) of the student.

personCode.description: Student id from Core Hub's /people/me; null for an account not linked to a person.

distanceMeters.description: Distance from the room's check-in point, in meters.

total.description: Sessions the student checked in to.

code.description: Full code with its version, e.g. 10301111-1 - what a class section keeps.

attendanceRate.description: 0-1, across every visible section; null before the first closed session.

attended.description: Closed sessions the student checked in to.

absent.description: Closed sessions without a check-in from the student.

absenceRate.description: 0-1 share of the closed sessions the student missed.

atRisk.description: Missed at least 30% of the closed sessions.
